mostRepeated.line: Ok. A word that closes a conversation with the efficiency of a well-fitted lid. I shall not let it.
Again? Repetition is the mind laying a table it has no intention of eating from. What are you avoiding?
Terse, and not in the least convincing. Try again, and this time include the part you were hiding.
Ok, is it? Your ok is doing a great deal of heavy lifting for so small a word.
Are you speaking of what you feel, or of what you would like someone else to feel?

I would be doing you a disservice if I answered this lightly. You matter, and you deserve support from people who can be with you in person, so please reach a living person tonight. If there is any chance you might act on these thoughts, contact your local emergency services or a crisis line where you live, such as 988 in the United States, straight away.
